title: More deliberate app permissions
summary:
A day of clearer app permissions, per-key usage views, and more accurate credit for the people building things.

The BYOP consent screen now fits shorter viewports and puts a spending limit and model access in clearer view. Account permissions are opt-in, and the separate Balance scope has been folded into Usage. API keys can read their own usage without account-wide usage access; the profile response also distinguishes basic identity fields from profile-scoped fields. Polli, the SDK, and key dialogs were updated to match.

Daily usage can now be filtered by selected API keys in the dashboard and through `/account/usage/daily`. The chart refetches when the selection changes, and keys appear as options even before they have usage. Detailed usage records now include `api_key_id`; the Detailed Usage CSV download remains.

BYOP analytics now use registered app `client_id` values to attribute activity, with a fallback for older requests. OpenClaw sends its client ID during authorization so newly issued keys carry that attribution.

highlights.title: Clearer app consent
highlights.text: Set a spending limit and choose which models an app can use on the redesigned consent screen. Account permissions are opt-in, with one Usage permission covering account balance and usage. [Connect user wallets](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/connect-user-wallets).

highlights.title: Usage by API key
highlights.text: Filter the dashboard's daily usage chart by API key, including keys that have no usage yet. [Open the dashboard](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: Filter daily usage requests
highlights.text: Pass comma-separated `api_key_ids` to `/account/usage/daily` to get daily usage for selected keys; the SDK accepts an `api_key_ids` array. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Read a key’s own usage
highlights.text: An API key can request its own usage through `GET /account/key/usage` without account-wide usage permission. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
